explanation: The nonce check in verify rejects tokens whose nonce is already in seen. Removing it would let a token be replayed. #123 is the related issue.
Call ensure_key_salt before constructing KeyManager. If salt setup fails, abort startup instead of initializing the manager.
Before allocating buf, topN must be no greater than maxSimpleTopN so the resulting Chunk slice stays at or below 1 MiB. maxSimpleTopN is the named limit.
When meta.abi_version is absent, abi must remain None; it must not default to the current ABI. #1784 is the related issue.
TLP reads /etc/tlp.conf after files matching /etc/tlp.d/*.conf, so values in the main file override the drop-in written at /etc/tlp.d/90-power.conf.

These settings require TLP version 1.10 or later. _AC, _BAT and _SAV identify profile-specific settings. Leaving the AC setting unset preserves the GNOME Performance toggle; this command sets only CPU_ENERGY_PERF_POLICY_ON_BAT.
On a JSON parse error, return null so the caller can log a warning; throwing here would bypass that path.

When an AllowedTools set is in force, remove --dangerously-skip-permissions from args because that flag bypasses --allowedTools. AllowedTools is the configured tool set; the two flags are command-line options.

For the verdicts returned by thunk_is_dead, consult the verdict table at is_definitely_dead_code in rust/xray-core/src/compiler/graph_preamble.rs. That path identifies a file and the text after the colon identifies a symbol.
repos_skipped is currently initialized to zero; it should be derived from the domains-to-repos mapping. #874 tracks that work.
index.regex_query uses a linear-time DFA for this pattern search, so its regex matching does not backtrack. regex_query names the method and DFA names the matching approach.

Keep the token-family table schema in this SQL coupled with RefreshTokenSqliteBackend._ensure_schema in src/storage/refresh_token_backend.py. Changes to these tables may require changes there; the path identifies the Python file and the text after the colon identifies the method.
The vendor batch API accepts at most 500 items, which is why MAX_BATCH is 500. doc:vendor-api#limits points to the limits section of the vendor-api documentation.

Keep these Status values in sync with STATUS_LABELS in web/src/status.ts. Their iota order determines stored integer values, so reordering them would change the meaning of existing stored values. #88 is the related issue.
Keep tenant_id first and created_at second in this index; that column order matches the orders_by_tenant query. orders_by_tenant names the query being served.
TList.Add relies on FCount never exceeding Length(FItems). Grow is the named operation that preserves that capacity condition.
Call _flush before closing the sink because closing drops _buf. Reversing the calls could discard buffered data.

Because userPath comes from a request, resolve it under workspaceRoot and reject paths containing .. that escape that root. The shown line resolves and normalizes the path; the comment also requires an escape check.
Drain ring before freeing buf. If buf is freed first, the IRQ handler could still use it and cause a use-after-free. #2201 is the related issue.

Reserve capacity for n items before adding them so the vector needs one allocation; growth during push_back accounted for 40% of the measured profile. doc:perf-notes#ingest points to the ingest section of the performance notes.
Use HOLDLOCK on this SQL Server MERGE to prevent concurrent upserts from racing. doc:mssql-merge#concurrency points to the concurrency section of the MERGE documentation.
Use an autonomous transaction for the audit write so its row survives if the caller rolls back its own transaction.

For the SQLite schema change, rebuild the table because SQLite ALTER TABLE cannot drop the relevant constraints. This CREATE TABLE starts the replacement table. doc:sqlite-alter#otheralter points to the referenced ALTER TABLE documentation section.
Poll every five seconds instead of relying on inotify because NFS mounts emit no inotify events for this purpose. The wait(5) call sets that interval.
Keep the for...of loop when awaiting run(job). Using await inside forEach would let errors escape the surrounding try/catch.
A decoded Vec<u8> frame must have length no greater than MAX_FRAME. read_frame's decoder rejects larger frames; MAX_FRAME is the named size limit.
Register drainHook before pool.start() so a SIGTERM can trigger a hook that drains the pool after it starts.

Move backoff's retry policy into configuration. The task is done when Default in internal/retry/policy.go reads that configuration; the path identifies a Go file and the text after the colon identifies the symbol.
Issue #412 contains the full matrix of allowed transitions among the LeaseState values Active, Released and Stale.
Pass the token to tool login through standard input, as --token-stdin requests. Never put it in command-line arguments because ps exposes argv to other users.
Create app_reader before granting it SELECT access. Migration 042 assumes that role already exists.
Make on_event idempotent because Stripe may retry the same webhook for three days. doc:stripe#webhook-retries points to the webhook-retries section of the Stripe documentation.
Compare the MAC values sig and expected with hmac.Equal for constant-time comparison. Using == could leak information through timing.
Build CodeGraph once per index, with work proportional to the number of edges. Do not rebuild it for each query.
The packed TCustomerRec layout is used by saved .dat files. Changing that layout would break existing files unless FILE_VERSION is bumped; FILE_VERSION names the file-format version.
Change MSG_MAX and MSG_MAX_WIRE together. MSG_MAX_WIRE is defined in proto/messages.h, and the two limits are coupled.
handler relies on session.userId being non-null after authMiddleware has run. authMiddleware is the named middleware that establishes that condition.
Keep the cache check and put inside this synchronized block so they are atomic together. A ConcurrentHashMap by itself would not make that sequence atomic.
Because the repository alias comes from a user, validate raw against the registry before joining it to a path. #1996 is the related issue.
Payment Amount must be nonnegative. Represent refunds as separate rows with Kind = 'R', rather than as negative amounts in this INSERT.
Set the stop flag before joining worker_. Without the signal to stop, worker_.join() could block forever.

The GitHub API limit described here is 5,000 requests per hour per token. The 720 ms limiter interval corresponds to that rate. doc:github-rest#rate-limits points to the rate-limits section of the GitHub REST documentation.
Stop the cidx service before installing a replacement binary at /usr/local/bin/cidx. Replacing the binary while it is running could fail with “Text file busy.”
Do not share _lease across jobs: doing so could leak credentials between users. #77 is the related issue.
Keep len(ids) at or below 999 when executing this DELETE, because the comment treats 999 as SQLite's per-statement bound-variable limit. Each ID is supplied as a bound variable.
If cgroup.create(limit) fails because the memory estimate is bad, log the error and let the job continue instead of aborting it.
Remove the legacy /v1/jobs route. #530 tracks that work; /v1 is the route version prefix.
The session model and the reason sessions are per tab are documented at doc:adr-007#session-model, an anchor in ADR 007. The comment applies to SessionRegistry.
This partial index includes only leases whose released_at is NULL. It made active-lease lookups 30 times faster, so keep that WHERE condition when maintaining the index.
Keep EVENT_TYPES synchronized with EVENT_LABELS in web/src/events.ts and with docs/events.md. Those paths identify the TypeScript label definition and the events documentation.
